title: Unregister PlaneBus overrides in vc_203_014_part2 Drop guard
goal: Call PlaneBus::global().unregister on topics::TOOLS_LIST, TOOLS_EXISTS, and TOOLS_EXECUTE inside RestoreAdvPlane::drop in tests/gmcp_requirements/vc_203_014_part2.rs before re-registering the default prefix handler so subsequent GMCP tests in the same process do not observe Unknown tool.

reuse.searched: Checked all seven PlaneBus::global().register(topics::TOOLS_*) call sites across tests/gmcp_requirements/; vc_203_014_part1, part3, part4 and vc_203_020 already call bus.unregister on the three exact topics in their Drop guards before susi_tools::plane_handler::register().
